verses.text: Haxo tiknaik ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek. Ha Jehová b'ojinak ex, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Manh ex xiwok, in kolnak ex, ix ex wawtej wal t'a he b'i, yujto wik ex.
Ayik ol ex ek' t'a yol ha ha', ayinek' heyet'ok. Ayik ol ex ek' t'a ha' niwak ha', manh ol he jik' ha'. Ayik ol ex ek' t'a skal te' k'ak', manh ol ex tz'ab'atok.
Ha in Jehová in, he Diosal in, he Kolumal waji. Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in wak'lab'ejnak Egipto, Etiopía yet' Seba he tojolok.
Ha heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo nakión swak'cham he k'exulok, yik wach' tzex kolchajkani, yujto te wach' ex wilani, te niwan eyelk'och t'ayin, tzex in xajanejpaxi.
Manh ex xiwok, ayinek' heyet'ok. Ol in molb'ejkot heb' eyetchonhab' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u, junxonhej ol ex ajok.

Ol wal t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stojolal norte icha tik: Chaek meltzaj heb', xin chama. Ol walpax t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a sur: Manh eyamoch waan heb'. Ik'ekkot heb' wuninal yet' heb' wisil aykanb'at t'a najat chi', b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik,
haton heb' ayoch in b'i t'ay. Ha in in b'onak heb', yik tzin yik'anchaanh heb', xin chama.
Ik'ekkot heb' in chonhab' t'a tik. Ay yol sat heb', palta max yil-laj heb', ay schikin heb', palta max yab'laj heb'.

Molb'ejek he b'a ex niwak chonhab', junnhej tzex aj ex chonhab'. ¿Mach he diosal aljinak tas wan yuji tik? ¿Mach heb' ayokto yalannakkan yuj tastak ujinakxo? Yik'okab'kot stestigo heb' tato yel yalnak heb', yik wach' tz'ojtakajeli to yel tas yalnak heb' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Ha ex israel ex tik, in testigo ex, in chekab' ex, sik'b'il ex el wuuj, yik wach' tzin eyojtakejeli, tzin eyak'anoch yipok he k'ool. Nachajokab'paxel eyuuj to Ha innhej Dios in. Malaj junokxo Dios ek'nakxo, ma toto ol jawok.
Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junok mach syal skolwaji.
Ha in walnak to ol ex in kolo', in testigo eyaji to ix elk'och jun chi'. Manhok junok komon Dios aljinak.
T'a junelnhej toxonton Dios in. Malaj junok mach syal skolanel sb'a t'a yol in k'ab', malaj mach syal stenanek' tas tzin k'ulej, xchi Dios.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Haxonhej Ochi, jun ix onh ak'anel libre, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ol in chekb'at heb' soldado yak' owal t'a Babilonia yik ol ex in kolani. Ol b'at heb' kaldeo chi' elelal t'a yol juntzanh barko syik'chaanh sb'a heb' yet'ok.
Ex israel, a in Jehová in in b'onak ex. E Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, he reyal in paxi, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová jakannak jun b'e t'a yol ha' mar, haton jun b'e ek'nak t'a snanhal ha'.
Yak'annak elta jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado yet'nak skarruaje yet' nok' chej, palta satnakel heb' yuj. Satnakel heb' smasanil, manhxalaj heb' kannak. Satnakem heb' icha stup sk'ak'al kandil.
Ha tiknaik syal Jehová t'a schonhab' icha tik: Manhxo he nakot tas ek'nakb'ati, manhxo he nakot tas ujinakxo.
Palta ay tas toto ol in k'ulej, ol heyila' to ol ujok juntzanh chi' tiknaik. Ay wal jun b'e ol in jak t'a takinh lu'um, ol k'eul a niwak ha' b'aj takinhtaxon sat.

Ol in yik'chaanh nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' okes yet' nok' awestruz, yujto ol wak' k'eul ha ha' t'a lum takinh lum chi'. Ol laj b'ey ha' b'aj takinhtaxon sat yik tzeyuk' ha' ex in chonhab' ex sik'b'il ex el wuuj tik.
B'ob'il ex wuuj, yik tzeyal wach' lolonel t'ayin.
Palta ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, majxo eyawtej in b'i, a tas ix he k'ulej, to ix ex tzaktzaj wet'ok.
Majxo eyak' nok' kalnel silab'il t'ayin, manhxa welk'och t'ayex yet' he silab' chi'. Maj in k'annhej ofrenda t'ayex, maj ex wak' pural eyak'an inkienso t'ayin.

Maj he manlaj te te' sumumi sjab' yik tzeyak' ofrendail t'ayin. Maj eyak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool yet' xepual nok' nok' ix eyak' silab'il. Palta anhej wal chukal tze k'ulej, in tzaktzaj wal yuj. Tze tzuntzejkot wowal yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej chi'.
Palta a in tik, yuj wal sniwanil welk'ochi, yuj chi' tzin suksat he chukal chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in nakot he mul chi'.
Tato ay wal tas tze na' t'a wib'anh jun, ko b'oek yaj tiknaik. Alekkoti, ol cheklajok tato malaj he mul.
Ha jun winh he b'ab'el mam icham, ochnak smul winh. Haxo heb' he k'ayb'umal, meltzajnakoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Yuj chi', ol wak' q'uixwelal heb' yajalil he templo a ex chonhab' Israel ex tik. Ex yinhtilal Jacob, ol ex waktejkani yik tzex satjieli yet' eyixtaji, xchi Jehová.
